title: Lucky_Luke´s Pack
description: This pack adds better visible ores and a new colorway for the GUI´s. It is inspired by the well known Lucky Luke himself!
body:
This resource pack refreshes Minecraft’s graphical user interface with a bold yellow and black color scheme inspired by the Lucky Luke aesthetic. The redesigned GUI elements focus on strong contrast and clear visuals, creating a distinctive look while staying easy to read and comfortable to use during gameplay.

In addition to the GUI changes, all ores have been visually adjusted to be more noticeable in the world. These adjustments improve clarity while mining by making ores stand out more naturally, without changing game mechanics or providing any unfair advantage.

The pack is designed for players who want a unique visual style and better visibility while keeping the vanilla gameplay experience intact. It is a purely visual resource pack and does not include cheats, hacks, or hidden features of any kind.

This resource pack works entirely on the client side and can be used in singleplayer as well as on multiplayer servers that allow custom resource packs. Installation is simple and follows the standard Minecraft resource pack setup.

No external services, data uploads, or third-party connections are used. The pack aims to be lightweight, transparent in its functionality, and fully compliant with Modrinth’s content guidelines.
